items.title: Harold Christophe Interview, 1961-08-01
items.q: Yeah, Wooden Joe was there too... Wooden Joe was a little dead. He just passed.

ctx.x: It was Wooden Joe. Wooden Joe was in there for a while too, wasn't it?

Yeah, Wooden Joe was there too, Wooden Joe was there too. You got, you got so many of them there. Yeah. Yeah, that's two years you remember all of them. Yeah, you have to do some memorization. Some of them there you can call out cause the future's there. Yeah, this is Raymond Glapion there. They buried him not so long. A lot of them there. And a lot of them in the past, I tell you. Yeah, cause down on this bottom row, a lot of them. Wooden Joe was a little dead. He just passed. Yeah, not so long. Yeah. And this…
